out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Poison/Toxic Material, Conditions of Use
violations.observation: A can of home-use pesticide Raid was observed being stored in the office/dry storage area
violations.corrective_action: Remove residential use pesticides from the facility. When necessary for pest control, chemical pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. OWNERSHIP DISCARDED THE CAN. CONTACT YOUR LICENSED PEST CONTROL OPERATOR FOR ROUTINE SERVICES.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Insect Control Devices, Design
violations.observation: Observed a bug light hanging above dishes and food.
violations.corrective_action: If insect control devices electrocute or stun insects, the device shall be designed to catch and hold the insects. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC TO MOVE THE BUG LIGHT TO A PLACE THAT IS NOT OVER A FOOD PREPARATION AREA.

violations.title: Dead or Trapped Pest Removed
violations.observation: Observed a dead mouse stuck to a glue board.
violations.corrective_action: Remove dead rodents, birds, and insects from the premises to ensure that the establishment is clean and sanitary and to prevent carcasses from attracting other pests. REMOVED DEAD MOUSE FROM PREMISES. DOMINION EATS (Inspection Date: 09/11/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Floors/Walls/Ceilings, Materials Smooth, Durable, Cleanable
violations.observation: The walk-in cooler was observed with a wooden floor.
violations.corrective_action: Wall, floor, and ceiling surfaces shall be smooth, durable, easily cleanable, and non-absorbent for areas subject to moisture such as food preparation areas, walk-in refrigerators, warewashing areas, and toilet rooms. REPLACE WOOD AND RUBBER MATS WITH A MATERIAL THAT IS SMOOTH, DURABLE, AND NON- ABSORBENT. FLOOR OF THE WALK IN NEEDS TO BE CLEANABLE.

violations.title: Premises Free of Unnecessary Items/Equipment
violations.observation: Observed a shelf of unused food storage containers and various cooking equipment being stored in the dry storage area and by the front hand sink
violations.corrective_action: Remove unnecessary items, including equipment which is no longer in use, from the premises to allow for regular and effective cleaning and to prevent harborage conditions. REMOVE ALL UNNECESSARY EQUIPMENT FROM PREMISES. THIS WILL AID IN BETTER CLEANING CAPABILITIES.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed an accumulation of dirt and debris in the following locations: 1) under the flat top 2) behind coolers 3) on all shelves, especially where the drinks, meat slicer, and dry goods are stored
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. MORE FREQUENT AND THOROUGH CLEANINGS ARE REQUIRED

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Paper towels were not provided at the hand sink
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC PLACED A ROLL OF PAPER TOWELS AT THE HAND SINK. HAND SINKS MUST ALWAYS HAVE PAPER TOWELS

out_items.name: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated

violations.title: Safe, Unadulterated & Honestly Presented
violations.observation: The following food item(s) is observed to be unsound or adulterated: moldy tomato paste, moldy heavy cream
violations.corrective_action: ALL food shall be safe, unadulterated and honestly presented as specified under 3-601.12. STAFF DISCARDED THE FOOD.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed cream cheese and milk being stored in the walk-in past the manufacturer’s expiration date
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. STAFF DISCARDED THE FOOD.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: Multiple bulk bins of ingredients and squeeze bottles were observed unlabeled
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. LABEL ALL FOOD STORAGE CONTAINERS AND SQUEEZE BOTTLES.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: 1) sandwich knife was observed being stored in between two prep top coolers
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. KNIFE SHOULD NOT BE STORED AT THIS LOCATION BECAUSE IT IS DIFFICULT TO CLEAN AND SANITIZE. STAFF MOVED KNIFE TO THE 3 COMPARTMENT SINK.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Fixed Equipment, Properly Spaced and Sealed
violations.observation: Handsink was observed not sealed to the wall. Handsink was loose upon inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment that is fixed because it is not easily movable shall be installed so that it is: 1) spaced to allow access for cleaning along the sides, behind, and above the equipment, 2) spaced from adjoining equipment, walls, and ceilings a distance of not more than 1 millimeter or one thirty-second inch, and 3) sealed to adjoining equipment or walls if the equipment is exposed to spillage or seepage. SEAL/CAULK HAND SINK TO THE WALL.
